requirements.name: Relevant degree or demonstrated equivalent
requirements.note: CV shows a Bachelor of Education and a teaching career with no engineering or signal-processing content; cover letter explicitly states 'My background is in secondary education rather than engineering' and 'I have no engineering background and would need substantial retraining to be useful.' Neither the degree nor any equivalent competence is asserted, so not_stated rather than a negative finding is recorded, per refuse_to_guess_rule.

requirements.name: Team-lead experience
requirements.note: Text describes coordinating a school competition and supervising student projects, and being a form tutor; none of this is described as formal leadership of a team, so kept conservative.

ask_in_screening.question: Can you describe any hands-on experience you have designing or implementing phased-array or beamforming signal-processing algorithms?
Can you describe any experience you have writing production embedded signal-processing software in C or C++ that runs on real hardware under real timing constraints?
Can you describe any experience you have writing production-quality Python code that is tested, maintained, and used by others?
Can you describe any hands-on RF test-bench experience you have, such as with network analysers, spectrum analysers, or anechoic-chamber measurement?
Can you describe your educational background, or any equivalent hands-on experience, relevant to electrical engineering, physics, or applied mathematics?
